tools.name: erpnext_account_list
tools.description: List Chart of Accounts. Filterable by root_type, is_group and disabled. Fields: name, account_name, account_type, root_type, parent_account, is_group, disabled. root_type values: Asset, Liability, Income, Expense, Equity. An account is 'active' when disabled is 0; pass disabled:false to count only t

disabled.description: Filter by disabled flag. Omit to list every account regardless of state.

tools.name: erpnext_financial_report
tools.description: Run one of ERPNext's standard financial reports and return its columns, rows and summary. filters.description: Report filters, passed to ERPNext unchanged. Most financial reports require at least 'company' plus a date range.

limit.description: Max report rows to return (default 100). Truncation is always reported in 'count', 'returned' and 'has_more'.

party.description: Filter by party — ID or name (e.g. 'HR-EMP-00024' or 'Acme Corp'). Requires 'party_type'.

voucher_type.description: Filter by source document type (Sales Invoice, Purchase Invoice, Payment Entry, Journal Entry, Expense Claim, ...)
